item.title: Sign up for the Go, Lunch! Summer Food Service Program today!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Sign up for the Go, Lunch! Summer Food Service Program Today!

Columbus Recreation and Parks Food Office presents Go, Lunch!, the program that provides free meals for kids in Central Ohio over the summer months.

The Department has partnered with hundreds of area organization Go, Lunch! to serve children breakfast, lunch and snack throughout the summer months. If your organization would like to join forces to provide safe, nutritious meals to kids in 2023, complete the site application today! All organizations must provide proof of nonprofit status and liability insurance.

For questions about Go, Lunch!, please contact us at (614) 645-3642 or FoodOffice@columbus.gov.

APPLY HERE

item.title: We need your help. Please spread the word about free produce in your community.
item.description:
Spread the Word About Free Produce!

Help Columbus Recreation and Parks Department distribute free produce by spreading the word about Mobile Produce Markets at a community center near you. Support a family in need this holiday season and encourage your network to pick up free fruits and vegetables this month. 

The sites available for distribution in December are:

  • 12/10 - Barnett Community Center -  1184 Barnett Rd. Columbus, OH 43227
  • 12/16 - Tuttle Park Community Center - 240 W. Oakland Ave., Columbus, OH 43219
  • 12/16 - Holton Community Center - 303 N Eureka Ave, Columbus, OH 43204
  • 12/17 - Far East Community Center - 1826 Lattimer Dr., Columbus, OH 43227

Distribution begins at 3 and runs while supplies last. 
View Schedule

Visit the Go Lunch! website to learn more about becoming a volunteer.  The city of Columbus Recreation and Parks Department is also looking for part-time candidates to provide seasonal support for our Mobile Produce Markets and other food office programs. 

Visit the Columbus.gov website to apply. 
Sign Up Now
